WORM'S-EYE UP THE MAINMAST — camera flat on the deck looking straight up the mast, yardarms crossing overhead as horizontal bars, rigging-lines converging at the masthead, sails billowing outward at the frame's top edge dramatizing towering scale.

CROW'S-NEST PLUNGE-DOWN — camera locked at the masthead crow's-nest rim looking straight down the mast-shaft, crew below reduced to small figures, the yardarms framing the corners, the deck's full layout exposed from above.

LONGBOAT-LOW HULL-WALL — camera at waterline from a bobbing longboat alongside a galleon, the barnacled hull rising as a vertical wall, gun-ports punched overhead, rigging scratching the sky at the very top of frame.

KRAKEN'S-POV UPWARD — camera submerged looking up at the ship-keel, trans-blue layered plates refracting the surface, tentacles wrapping the hull fore and aft, crew silhouetted through the deck-planking above.

BROADSIDE GAP BETWEEN SHIPS — camera at wave-crest height in the open water BETWEEN two engaged galleons, both hulls flanking the frame left and right, cannon-fire arcing across the gap, smoke-billows meeting in the middle.

THROUGH-RIGGING LATTICE DOWN — camera nestled between the mainmast topsail and lower yardarm looking down through crossing rope-lines to deck-action below, the diagonal rigging-lattice framing the crew like a cage.

OVER-SHOULDER CUTLASS DUEL — camera just behind the right shoulder of one combatant, past their raised cutlass-arm at the opponent mid-parry on the quarterdeck gangway, the opponent's grimace fully legible, sea visible behind them.

CHEST-LEVEL TREASURE APPROACH — camera at minifig chest-height behind a pirate advancing on a half-open treasure-chest, jewels and doubloons glinting in the foreground, the pirate's reaching C-grip hand breaking into frame.

CAPTAIN'S CABIN FOURTH-WALL — camera at the missing stern-wall looking into the captain's cabin interior, chart-table centered, lantern swinging overhead, the stern-window behind the captain framing open brick-water beyond.

SHIPWRECK DUTCH-TILT — camera tilted 30 degrees to mirror the broken-backed wreck canted on a reef, the diagonal hull dominating the frame, surf-foam pieces around the base, the stern cocked high on the wreck's high side.

DOCK-END RECEDING PERSPECTIVE — camera at the seaward dock-end looking landward down its full length, crates and crew receding in perspective toward a moored sloop at the far end, dock-lanterns marking the vanishing line.

CANNON-DECK FIRING SEQUENCE — camera inside the gun-deck at knee-height, three cannon barrels receding in perspective toward open gun-ports, gun-crews mid-swab-and-load, muzzle-flash trans-elements punching through the nearest port.

AERIAL OVER HIDDEN COVE — camera directly overhead between two cliff-walls framing the cove like parentheses, a sloop pulling into shadow-water below, the open ocean a brighter blue beyond the cove's narrow entrance.

YARDARM OVERHANG DOWN-SHOT — camera positioned at the end of the main yardarm looking down and inward along its length toward the mast, a crew-member edging out on the footrope below, the deck tiny beneath them.

UNDER-YARDARM WORM'S-EYE — camera directly beneath the lower yardarm looking up at its underside, the sail bellying away from the frame-top, rigging-blocks and tackle hanging into the foreground, the mast shooting upward behind.

KRAKEN-TENTACLE TIGHT-CROP — camera flush against a single tentacle coiling around the mainmast, the sucker-texture filling the foreground, a sailor clinging to the mast above in the upper frame, the rest of the ship cropped away.

HOLD-CUTAWAY CROSS-SECTION — camera at the removed hull-panel looking into the ship's hold, cargo-barrels and crates stacked in layers, a lantern swinging from a deck-beam overhead, bilge-water trans-plates at the very bottom of frame.

BELOW-DECKS CORRIDOR TUNNEL — camera at minifig eye-level walking the belowdecks corridor, hammocks slung overhead like a low ceiling, crew and cargo receding into the far bulkhead, the corridor compressing the perspective into a tunnel.

QUARTERDECK MUTINY HIGH-ANGLE — camera at the mainmast mid-height looking down onto the quarterdeck, the captain isolated at the stern-rail with two loyalists, the mutinous crew arrayed in a tight crescent, the angle pinning him against the rail.

BOARDING RAIL-EDGE LEAP — camera at the rail of the attacking ship looking across the gap at the enemy's rail, boarders mid-leap through the air, the rail's edge as a sharp foreground bar, smoke drifting between the two hulls.

LANTERN-GLOW BELOW-FACE — tight-crop on a single minifig below-decks holding a trans-yellow lantern, the glow lighting their chin and cheekbones from beneath, the surrounding gunroom fallen into deep shadow, conspiratorial and close.

BURIED-CHEST DIG OVERHEAD — camera at palm-tree crown height looking straight down at a beach dig-site, six pirates radiating around a half-unearthed chest, palm-frond shadows raking the sand, the excavated pit a dark pit-shadow.

STORM-DECK CHAOS TIGHT — camera at deck-level with trans-clear rain-rod pieces streaking diagonally across frame, crew lashed to the mainmast shrouds in the background, a loose cannon sliding toward the foreground on the tilted deck.

FIGUREHEAD-NOSE POV — camera positioned at the bowsprit's end just behind the figurehead looking back along the ship's full length, the bowsprit receding toward the foremast, the full deck and quarterdeck visible in forced perspective.

JOLLY-ROGER FLAG POV DOWN — camera at the masthead flag-staff looking down and forward past the Jolly Roger's skull-and-crossbones, the flag-edge cutting across the top of frame, the deck below at a steep plunging angle through the fabric.

WORM'S-EYE UP THE FOREMAST — camera flat on the deck planking looking straight up the foremast, yardarms crossing like rungs overhead, rigging-lines converging at the masthead, topsail billowing into the sky beyond.

CROW'S-NEST PLUNGE — camera locked at the masthead crow's-nest rim looking straight down, the mast a narrow spike plunging to the deck far below, crew figures tiny and ant-like, yardarms framing the upper corners.

LONGBOAT-LOW GALLEON WALL — camera at water-level from a longboat's bow, the galleon hull rising as a sheer plank-wall above, gun-ports punched overhead, anchor-chain vanishing upward, the dwarfing scale dramatized in a single vertical frame.

UNDER THE YARDARM VERTIGO — camera beneath the main yardarm looking up along its length, the yardarm receding in forced perspective, sail-cloth overhead, ratlines dropping away on both sides, the height of the yard made viscerally steep.

BROADSIDE GAP — camera at wave-top height in the open-water gap between two engaged galleons, both hulls bracketing the frame left and right, broadside fire and smoke arcing across the gap, the engagement claustrophobically close.

CANNON-DECK RECEDING — camera inside the gun-deck at one end, three cannons receding in perspective toward open gun-ports, gun-crews mid-reload, muzzle-smoke rolling through the port-openings, the low deckhead pressing down above.

THROUGH-RIGGING LATTICE — camera positioned between the topsail yard and the mainsail looking down through crossing ropes and blocks to deck-action below, the rigging forming a diagonal lattice that frames the scene like a net.

GUNROOM CROSS-SECTION — camera at the cutaway hull-face of the gunroom below the waterline, powder-monkeys and shot-racks visible in the interior, the hull-planking framing the scene, the waterline pressing just above the ceiling.

KRAKEN'S-EYE UPWARD — camera submerged beneath the ship-keel looking up through layered trans-blue plates, tentacles wrapping the hull's copper-sheathed bottom, crew silhouettes visible on the deck-surface above, the waterline refracting the light.

TENTACLE TIGHT-CROP — camera hard against a single kraken tentacle coiling around the mainmast, suckers filling the foreground plate-by-plate, a sailor clinging to the mast above in the upper frame, the rest of the ship cropped away.

CHEST-LEVEL DISCOVERY — camera at minifig chest-height three-quarter behind a pirate approaching an open chest, the chest's trans-jewel contents dominating the foreground, the pirate's reaching C-grip visible, the jungle clearing receding beyond.

CORPSE-DISCOVERY POV — camera at boot-level approaching a skeleton slumped against the hold-wall, the skeleton's outstretched hand filling the foreground, a parchment map loosely gripped, the discoverer's feet visible at frame-edge.

BOARDING-PARTY OVER-THE-RAIL — camera at the rail of the attacking ship looking across the gap, three boarders mid-leap, the enemy ship's rail as the landing target, the gap between hulls dropping to churned water below.

QUARTERDECK MUTINY HIGH — camera at the mainmast crosstrees looking down at the quarterdeck, the captain isolated at the stern-rail, mutineers in a tightening semicircle, the angle pressing down to make the captain's ground shrink.

DOCK-END PERSPECTIVE — camera at the seaward end of a dock looking back along its length toward the moored brig, crates and coiled rope in receding perspective, dock-lanterns flanking the path, the ship-bow dominating the far terminus.

AERIAL OVER THE COVE — overhead from a cliff-top perch looking down into a hidden cove, cliff-walls bracketing the frame like parentheses, a sloop nosing into the inlet, the cove's trans-blue water distinct from the open ocean beyond.

LANTERN-GLOW CONSPIRATORIAL — camera tight on a single pirate crouched in the hold, a trans-yellow lantern held below chin-height, the lantern's glow pooling on their face and the map spread across the deck, all surroundings in shadow.

GALLEY BELOW-DECKS TUNNEL — camera at a minifig walking the belowdecks galley corridor, hammocks slung from the low deckhead overhead, salt-barrel stores and sleeping crew receding in perspective, the corridor framing the scene like a brick-vaulted tunnel.

STORM-DECK CHAOS — camera flat on the heaving deck with trans-clear bar rain-rods streaking diagonally across the frame, a sailor lashed to the mainmast rigging in the background, loose cargo mid-slide toward the scuppers.

BURIED-CHEST OVERHEAD — camera from a palm-tree perch looking straight down at a beach dig-site, six crew members radiating around a half-excavated chest, palm-shadow lines raking across the sand, shovels and scatter in the surrounding radius.

LONGBOAT ROWING STERN-CHASE — camera at the stern of a longboat at water-level, six oarsmen receding in perspective toward the bow, a pursuing frigate filling the horizon behind the camera-anchor, the wake churning through the trans-blue gap.

MAST-CAP YARDARM DOWN-SHOT — camera positioned on the mast-cap looking down along the horizontal yardarm's length, the yard receding to its tip above open ocean, a topman working the footrope below the yard, deck a vertical drop beneath.

YARDARM VERTIGO DOWN — camera mounted at the yardarm tip looking straight down past the sail-bellying canvas to the ant-scale crew on the deck below, the yardarm itself a horizontal bar dividing sky from deck-chaos.

LONGBOAT-BOW LOOKING UP — camera at waterline inside an approaching longboat's bow, the galleon's barnacled hull rising as a sheer vertical wall, gun-ports yawning overhead, rigging and sky at the very top edge of frame.

HOLD-CUTAWAY GALLEY LEVEL — camera at the missing fourth wall of the ship's galley cross-section, cook-fire trans-orange centered, hanging provisions and barrels receding toward the bow, the deck-planks above pressing down on the cramped interior.
